one_line_description: VentureRank OS is a venture studio operating system that ranks startup ideas, scores them by strategic criteria, groups them into priority buckets, and generates spawn packs for the highest-value opportunities.
target_users: founders deciding what to build first
operators turning opportunity analysis into execution
micro-funds and angels comparing early venture theses
core_problem: Startup builders lose time and conviction when ideas are not scored, ranked, compared, or translated into concrete execution packs.
core_solution: A founder-grade operating system that normalizes startup ideas into weighted scores, priority buckets, confidence-adjusted rankings, portfolio queues, and spawn packs.
mvp_scope: idea detail with scoring and spawn pack preview
mock fallback with optional Supabase reads
product_flows: founder opens dashboard and reviews top conviction ideas
founder compares all ideas by bucket and confidence-adjusted score
founder opens an idea detail page to inspect metrics, rationale, risks, and recommended action
founder generates or previews a spawn pack for a high-priority idea
operator intakes a new idea for later persistence and scoring

design_system.theme: dark premium founder-grade venture studio OS
design_system.layout: clean dashboard cards, ranked tables, queue columns, sharp hierarchy
design_system.avoid: generic SaaS fluff, overcomplicated animation, Autobuilder public language

preserve_rules: preserve scoring formulas and decision buckets
preserve public assets that are used
do_not_rules: do not deploy to Vercel automatically
do not push to GitHub automatically
do not require Supabase env vars at build time
do not create app-owned tables in public schema
do not expose Autobuilder language publicly
do not turn this into a generic SaaS dashboard

autobuilder_strategy.highest_leverage_next_move: persist intake and spawn packs to Supabase using generated venturerank_os database types

last_recovery_summary.deploy_readiness: ready for manual Vercel deploy after fresh pnpm install/build
last_recovery_summary.summary: Fixed root app shadowing, restored real product route build, kept Supabase lazy with mock fallback, cleaned lint/typecheck issues, hardened migrations, validated required routes, and prepared foundation memory files.
